de.department_code AS dept_code, d.department_name AS dept_name, de.role_code AS dept_role_code, dr.role_name AS dept_role_name, de.is_primary

ORDER BY client_id user_id first_name last_name system_role created_at ASC DESC

LEFT JOIN department_employees de ON e.client_id = de.employee_id AND de.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN departments d ON de.department_code = d.department_code AND d.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN roles dr ON de.role_code = dr.role_code AND dr.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

LEFT JOIN team_employees te ON e.client_id = te.employee_id AND te.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN teams t ON te.team_code = t.team_code AND t.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN roles tr ON te.role_code = tr.role_code AND tr.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

-- Permissions từ system role LEFT JOIN roles sr ON e.system_role = sr.role_code AND sr.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN role_permissions srp ON sr.role_code = srp.role_code LEFT JOIN permissions sp ON srp.permission_code = sp.permission_code -- Permissions từ department roles LEFT JOIN role_permissions drp ON de.role_code = drp.role_code LEFT JOIN permissions dp ON drp.permission_code = dp.permission_code -- Permissions từ team roles LEFT JOIN role_permissions trp ON te.role_code = trp.role_code LEFT JOIN permissions tp ON trp.permission_code = tp.permission_code

LEFT JOIN department_employees de2 ON e2.client_id = de2.employee_id AND de2.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN departments d2 ON de2.department_code = d2.department_code AND d2.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN roles dr2 ON de2.role_code = dr2.role_code AND dr2.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

LEFT JOIN team_employees te2 ON e2.client_id = te2.employee_id AND te2.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN teams t2 ON te2.team_code = t2.team_code AND t2.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN roles tr2 ON te2.role_code = tr2.role_code AND tr2.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
ORDER BY e2.client_id e2.user_id e2.first_name e2.last_name e2.system_role e2.created_at ASC DESC
